title: Lattice-data-driven specific heat and isentropic bulk modulus of SU(3) gluon matter at finite temperature
summary: We investigate the specific heat and isentropic bulk modulus of finite-temperature pure SU(3) gauge matter within a lattice-data-driven phenomenological framework. The equation of state is formulated in terms of a temperature-dependent effective gluon mass constrained { by lattice QCD pressure data as input, allowing the pressure}, trace anomaly, gluon number density, energy per thermally active gluonic mode, and derivative-sensitive response functions to be derived in a thermodynamically consistent manner.
